# Sub-processors

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:privacy` from packages/shared/src/subprocessors.ts. Do not edit. -->

Who may process personal data on the platform's behalf. A tenant sees only the providers it has
configured; this is the complete set the software can connect to.

> This is a draft for the controller and counsel to confirm vendor by vendor. It is not legal advice.

## Model and voice providers (chosen per tenant)

| Kind | Vendor | Role | Location | Personal data | Transfer |
| ---- | ------ | ---- | -------- | ------------- | -------- |
| anthropic | Anthropic | Language model: interviewer turns, summaries, extraction, analysis | United States (see vendor's data-residency options) | Interview answers and file summaries as prompt text; Pseudonymous session context | Outside the EEA: standard contractual clauses or the vendor's equivalent; confirm in the vendor's DPA |
| openai | OpenAI | Language, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, realtime voice and embeddings | United States (see vendor's data-residency options) | Answers as prompt text; Voice audio and its transcript; Document text for embeddings | Outside the EEA: standard contractual clauses or the vendor's equivalent; confirm in the vendor's DPA |
| openrouter | OpenRouter and the model vendor it routes to | Language model gateway | Depends on the model vendor chosen per route | Interview answers and file summaries as prompt text | Two processors in a chain; confirm both and the routing policy |
| litellm | The organization's own LiteLLM gateway, and the vendors behind it | Language model gateway operated by the tenant | Chosen by the tenant | Interview answers and file summaries as prompt text | Determined by the tenant's gateway configuration |
| openai_compatible | Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint the tenant configures | Language model, as configured | Chosen by the tenant | Interview answers and file summaries as prompt text | Determined by the endpoint the tenant names; the platform operator must approve it |
| stt | The speech-to-text vendor the tenant configures | Transcription of recorded answers | Chosen by the tenant | Voice audio; Transcript | Determined by the vendor named |
| tts | The text-to-speech vendor the tenant configures | Spoken interviewer voice | Chosen by the tenant | Interviewer text (may paraphrase an answer) | Determined by the vendor named |
| realtime | The realtime-voice vendor the tenant configures | Live voice conversation | Chosen by the tenant | Live voice audio; Transcript | Determined by the vendor named |
| local | None (runs on the platform's own server) | Transcription of recorded answers with Whisper on the API host | The platform's own server | Voice audio, processed in memory | None: audio does not leave the server |

## Infrastructure (part of every deployment)

| Service | Vendor | Role | Location | Personal data | Transfer |
| ------- | ------ | ---- | -------- | ------------- | -------- |
| Hosting | The VPS provider chosen by the operator (EU region for the reference deployment) | Runs the application, the database, file storage and backups | European Union (operator's choice; confirm per deployment) | Everything the platform stores | None when hosted in the EEA |
| Email | The SMTP service the operator or tenant configures | Invitations, verification codes and notifications | Chosen by the operator | Email address; Message text | Determined by the SMTP service |
| Certificates | Let's Encrypt (through Caddy) | TLS certificate issuance | United States | The public hostname only; no personal data | None: no personal data |
